title: Nero Caesar
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Gittin 56a it is told that the Romans sent him to destroy Jerusalem, and when he came to the Land of Israel he found a child and said to him: Recite to me your verse. The child said to him: "And I will lay My vengeance upon Edom by the hand of My people Israel." He said: The Holy One, blessed be He, wishes to destroy His house and wishes to wipe His hands on that man? He fled, went, and converted, and Rabbi Meir descended from him.

notes.text: That man is the speaker’s reference to himself in the account. The conversion and Meir-descent statements are retained as part of the Gittin narrative.
